data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 205.27m. During 2018 the Syndicate recorded prior year favourable development (a release) of approximately GBP 6.76m gross (c.GBP 3.94m net), driven by favourable development in Property (notably reductions in ultimate hurricane losses), partially offset by adverse development in Marine, Third Party Liability, Miscellaneous lines and reinsurance items. Catastrophe events during the year (notably Californian wildfires and Hurricane Michael) contributed to 2018 claims activity but the overall prior-year reserve movement was a modest release.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal drivers were a combination of catastrophe events (notably Californian Wildfires and Hurricane Michael) and reserve deterioration on certain products (predominantly longer tail classes).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year comparative). Prior year development (gross) taken from Technical Provisions note 'Change in prior year provisions' gross column (2018: 6,760 GBP 000) and converted to -6.76m to follow the required sign convention (negative = release). The report prints a net prior year favourable development of GBP 3.942m; table of LOB movements in the notes is net of reinsurance and was used (with sign conversion) to populate lob_movements. Some tables in the report use an internal sign convention (positive/parentheses) that differs from the JSON sign rule; values have been normalized to the JSON convention. Confidence scores reflect explicit table values; amounts labelled as 'reduced' or 'reduction' have been interpreted as releases where gross/net ambiguity exists.
